Run-up before earnings, out before the r.how: buy the open 3 sessions before the report, sell at the last close before it (never holds through the result)

Run-up before earnings, uptrend only.how: same, only stocks above their 20 day average

Hold through earnings, 1 day.how: buy at the close before the report, sell at the close of the reaction day

Hold through earnings, 3 days.how: buy at the close before the report, sell 3 sessions later

Hold through earnings, uptrend only.how: same, only stocks above their 20 day average

After a strong report, 5 days.how: report day gapped up 5%+ and held; buy the next open, sell 5 sessions later

After a beat and a strong reaction, 5 da.how: same, and earnings beat the estimate

Bounce after a 20% fall, 3 days.how: fell 20%+ on real volume; buy the next open, sell 3 sessions later
